info.title: Easy-Peasy.AI Universal API
info.description: All-in-one AI platform for text generation, image generation, video generation, transcription, text-to-speech, sound effects, chat completions, and bot conversations.

post.description: Creates a chat completion in Easy-Peasy.AI.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

messages[].description: The chat message array in OpenAI-compatible format with role and content per item.

model.description: Optional chat model override such as gpt-4.1-mini.

maxTokens.description: Optional maximum number of tokens to generate.

post.description: Generates a sound effect in Easy-Peasy.AI.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the sound effect to generate.

duration.description: Optional target duration for the sound effect.

promptInfluence.description: Optional prompt adherence level from 0.0 to 1.0.

post.description: Generates a talking video in Easy-Peasy.AI.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

image.description: Optional face image URL to animate.

video.description: Optional source video URL to lip-sync.

text.description: Optional speech text when you are not providing an audio file.

voiceId.description: Optional TTS voice identifier when using text input.

audio.description: Optional audio file URL to use directly.

avatarModel.description: Optional avatar generation mode for image-based talking videos.

resolution.description: Optional output resolution for the talking video.

generateCaptions.description: Whether to generate captions on the output video.

captionColor.description: Optional caption highlight color in hex format.

post.description: Generates text in Easy-Peasy.AI from a preset.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

preset.description: The preset slug or identifier used for text generation.

keywords.description: The prompt keywords or source text used to generate output.

tone.description: Optional tone to apply to the generated text.

outputs.description: Optional number of generated outputs to return.

language.description: Optional target language for generated text.

shouldUseGpt4.description: Use the GPT-4 generation path when supported.

suffix.description: Optional suffix appended to the generated output.
